messages:
Maria: Heads-up — cust_acme is seeing their embedding pipeline fail after we froze a variant. They say vectors used to be 1536 and are now 1024, causing their ANN index to reject ingests.

Maria: customer paste: `IndexError: vector length mismatch: expected 1536 got 1024`

Lee: Ack, digging in. Do we have the pinned variant id they used?

Maria: They pinned `redwood-v2-small@2026-03-01` per ticket. They said the pin was set last week.

Tim: That model's baseline embedding dim is 1024 in our catalog notes. Did we silently swap catalog metadata when the quantized build landed?

Jordan: Possible. I'm pulling the deploy history for that variant.

ops-bot: deploy-event: variant redwood-v2-small@2026-03-01 rolled -> artifact qbuild-2026-03-12 on pool eu-west-2 at 2026-03-14T04:12:09Z

Lee: Customer also provided a repro curl they run in their ingest job: 

Lee: ```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2-small@2026-03-01","input":["doc1","doc2"]}'
```

Maria: Response snippet they get: `{"data":[{"embedding":[...1024 floats...] }], "model":"redwood-v2-small@2026-03-01"}`

Tim: Ok so model API returns 1024. Customer's indexer expects 1536. Two possibilities: 1) Customer originally used a different model (1536) and pinned the wrong name, or 2) our model artifact previously emitted 1536 and an artifact change made it 1024 but we left the pinned name unchanged.

Jordan: I compared the manifest for that variant from before the freeze: `manifest.model_embedding_size: 1536` on 2026-02-26. Current manifest shows `model_embedding_size: 1024` for the same variant id. That's a red flag.

Lee: Can you paste the manifest diff?

Jordan: ```diff
- model_embedding_size: 1536
+ model_embedding_size: 1024
- artifact: build-abc123
+ artifact: qbuild-xyz789
```

Maria: Customer says they set the pin to guarantee no behavior changes — they did not expect dimension change. They're blocked; their ingestion pipeline dropped 20% of docs due to shape assertions.

Tim: Root cause: our variant alias pointed to a new artifact after we rolled a quantized build under the same variant tag. Pin semantics should prevent that; looks like the pin operation locked routing but allowed artifact updates.

Lee: Is there a quick rollback we can do for the customer? If we can re-point that variant id to the previous artifact (build-abc123) temporarily they can resume.

Jordan: I can backfill a rollback patch. Two questions: does the pinned variant belong to a customer-scoped namespace or global? If global, rollbacks affect others.

Maria: For this customer it's a per-customer lock according to the ticket metadata — they used `account:acme:locked-variant`.

Lee: Good. Jordan, please flip the variant to artifact build-abc123 in staging for a sanity check, then we can apply to their reserved pool.

Jordan: Will do. Repro checklist I used:
- Call embeddings endpoint with `model=redwood-v2-small@2026-03-01`
- Inspect `model` field and len(embedding)
- Verify manifest from model-catalog service `GET /catalog/variants/{id}`

Maria: Customer also reported intermittent differences when batching (they use batchpad). They see 1536 for single requests sometimes and 1024 for batched.

Tim: That smells like runtime fallback: non-quantized kernel for small sequences, quantized artifact for batched paths. We need to check kernel-selection logs on the serving node.

ops-bot: trace: request 0f3a -> served by node rwinf-08, kernel-path: quantized-mha-v2, runtime-fallback: false

Jordan: I pulled node logs — for some older nodes the load-balancer still sent to a node with the older artifact. There's an inconsistency in our routing table: some nodes still register artifact build-abc123 (1536) and others qbuild-xyz789 (1024) under the same variant name. That's the inconsistency the customer sees.

Lee: Not good. Need a coordinated drain and restart so variant mapping is consistent across the reserved pool.

Maria: Proposed customer communication: apologetic, timeline for rollback + pool restart, and a mitigation: temporary accept both dims on their indexer or backfill vector resize helper.

Tim: Also add a fix in the pinning logic: pins must freeze artifact id, not only alias. I'll open an engineering ticket and tag Eng-Platform.

Jordan: For now I'm going to: 1) flip their customer-scoped variant to build-abc123, 2) restart serving nodes in their reserved pool, 3) validate embeddings length across 5 sample requests, 4) confirm with customer.

Maria: Thanks. Customer asked for ETA — can we target 90m?

Jordan: ETA 75-90m. I'll update thread when done.

ops-bot: incident-note: engineer Jordan assigned to task rwinf-4321 (rollback + pool-consistency)

Maria: Noted. Jordan please include the manifest diff and the node registry snapshot when you close.

Jordan: Will do — updating now."
